metadata.loading: hydrostatic preload; fixed periodic cell fluctuation eigenproblem

definitions.s: mean pressure of all owner tiles in planted patch / applied pressure; finite-R estimate, not proven limit
definitions.norm: max and rms share max_e |n_P| denominator; relative_l2 matches reference RMS convention
definitions.core: complete owner tiles [lo+w,hi-w)^d as upstream prestress/convergence.py
definitions.mode: strict physical interior of whole patch; Q=K-p H/p0; e=(Qomega-QP(s*p))/K uses full end wrenches
definitions.fixed: fixed absolute central 4x4 tiles (2D), 2x2x2 cells (3D); geometry phase mapped to planted motif
definitions.limitations: one nested random background per L, periodic finite box, no infinite-volume convergence proof
